item.title: Suspect in Leiderdorp murder had been scheduled for court over death threats
item.description: The suspect in the murder of a 52-year-old woman from Leiderdorp was already under supervision from the authorities.

item.title: Rotterdam court upholds €1.1 million fine against Fortnite developer Epic Games
item.description: The Rotterdam District Court has upheld a decision by the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) to fine Epic Games International, the developer of Fortnite.

item.title: Maastricht City Councillor arrested on terrorism charge; Tied to Atlanta KLM incident
item.description: Police in Maastricht arrested a 32-year-old City Council member for threatening to drive onto a crowded shopping street with the intent to run people over.

item.title: Something fishy: Police find 300 kg of cocaine in frozen snapper shipment
item.description: The police and customs discovered 319 kilos of cocaine in a container of deep-frozen fish on Monday. The drugs were found at a company in Barneveld, and had come from Suriname.

item.title: Two dogs killed in Oss car accident; Owner dies after returning home
item.description: Two dogs were killed Sunday evening in Oss when they were struck by a car while being walked, and their 55-year-old owner later died of natural causes after returning home, police said.

item.description: AZ ran riot against Ajax on Tuesday evening, dismantling the Amsterdam side 6–0.
